mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_chat_session WHERE status = '0' AND create_time >= #{since90}) AS totalSessions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_chat_record WHERE del_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{since90}) AS totalMessages, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_chat_session WHERE status = '0' AND create_time >= #{todayStart} AND create_time < #{tomorrowStart}) AS todaySessions, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(token_usage), 0) FROM ai_chat_record WHERE del_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{since90}) AS totalTokenUsage
SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS sessionCount, 0 AS messageCount FROM ai_chat_session WHERE create_time >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE(create_time)
SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, 0 AS sessionCount, COUNT(*) AS messageCount FROM ai_chat_record WHERE del_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE(create_time)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalReplies, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS errorCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'aborted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS abortedCount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN first_token_ms IS NOT NULL THEN first_token_ms END)), 0) AS avgFirstTokenMs, COALESCE(MAX(first_token_ms), 0) AS maxFirstTokenMs, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN total_ms IS NOT NULL THEN total_ms END)), 0) AS avgTotalMs, COALESCE(MAX(total_ms), 0) AS maxTotalMs, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN token_usage IS NOT NULL AND token_usage > 0 THEN token_usage END)), 0) AS avgTokenUsage FROM ai_chat_record WHERE del_flag = 0 AND role = 'assistant' AND create_time >= #{since}

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS replyCount, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN first_token_ms IS NOT NULL THEN first_token_ms END)) AS avgFirstTokenMs, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN total_ms IS NOT NULL THEN total_ms END)) AS avgTotalMs, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errorCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'aborted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abortedCount FROM ai_chat_record WHERE del_flag = 0 AND role = 'assistant' AND create_time >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY DATE(create_time)
